About.label: About Me
About.heading: Dedicated to continuous growth.
About.p1: I am a graduate of D3 Information Management from the University of Riau with a strong focus on web development and IT services. I have a proven track record in designing and building web application systems using PHP, Laravel, Next.js, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap, combined with hands-on experience handling customer inquiries and troubleshooting digital platforms.
About.p2: Driven by great curiosity, I am a fast learner who is responsive and highly adaptable to new work environments and technologies. I am accustomed to collaborating in teams, communicative, and always enthusiastic about designing efficient, scalable, and positively impactful technology solutions.
About.p3: I am very open to freelance opportunities, internships, and entry-level positions in the technology field. My focus is always on delivering solutions that not only work well but are also centered on user satisfaction.
